g.text: A lower price can still come with a high burden
Each dot is one county. Dashed lines mark Pennsylvania’s directly estimated statewide figures.
Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020–2024 ACS, tables B25064 and B25070, via Census Reporter.
Burden means spending 30%+ of household income on gross rent; ratios not computed are excluded.
